description: EchoStar Corporation is a holding company that was organized in October 2007 as a corporation under the laws of the State of Nevada, whose Class A common stock is publicly traded on the NASDAQ Global Select Market under the symbol SATS, with principal executive offices located at 9601 South Meridian Boulevard, Englewood, Colorado. In the third quarter of 2025 it resolved the Federal Communications Commission's review into EchoStar's compliance with its build-out milestones and other obligations regarding its federal spectrum licenses, having previously received an FCC letter on May 9, 2025 indicating that the FCC was beginning a review of its compliance with certain obligations to provide 5G broadband service.
